what: 1. Helper parser is specified as jq -nsR with inputs, which produces no input rows under jq slurp mode
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed helper would fail closed for every valid JSONL events file, so all three Codex launchers silently stop recording Codex costs
suggested_fix: Use jq -nR with inputs for line streaming, or use jq -Rsn over the slurped string with split("\n")[]; pin a harness fixture that invokes the exact jq mode on a valid JSONL file

what: 2. INPUT is mapped to usage.input_tokens while CACHED_INPUT is added again, but OpenAI documents input_tokens as including cached tokens
scenario_or_breakage: In a cache-heavy run with input_tokens=1000 cached_tokens=900 output_tokens=50, the plan records input=1000 cache_read=900 total=1950 instead of billing buckets input=100 cache_read=900 output=50 total=1050, silently corrupting cost reports
suggested_fix: Compute uncached input as input_tokens - cached_tokens before writing the ledger, fail closed if cached_tokens exceeds input_tokens, and update tests to assert the subtraction; source checked: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/usage/completions

what: 3. The plan requires stdout-routed auth failures to remain classified, but the proposed split sends stdout to the events sidecar while auth checks still read only SIDECAR or SIDECAR_LOG
scenario_or_breakage: If Codex exits nonzero and prints unauthorized/login-required text on stdout under --json, the retry loop misses it and CI emits an unknown/other failure instead of auth; the proposed stdout-auth test cannot pass with the listed launcher edits
suggested_fix: Update Codex retry and verdict calls to check both stderr sidecar and events sidecar, or tee non-JSON stdout lines into the sidecar before parsing; mirror the existing Cursor multi-sidecar pattern

what: 4. fromjson? skips malformed JSON even though malformed JSONL is listed as an exit-1 fail-closed condition
scenario_or_breakage: A truncated events file with one valid usage event followed by a malformed JSON event can succeed and record a partial undercount instead of failing closed
suggested_fix: Distinguish wrapper noise from malformed event lines: ignore known non-JSON wrapper/status lines, but treat lines that look like JSON and fail parsing as exit 1; add a mixed valid-usage plus truncated-JSON fixture
